how_to_apply: Get the prescribed form from the Principal's office, Govt ITI Durg, during office hours, or download it from https://govtitidurg.org or https://cgiti.cg.gov.in/iti/durg.
Fill the form neatly and legibly without overwriting, and sign the form and the affidavit.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates, marksheets and the Chhattisgarh domicile certificate.
Write the trade/subject name and the institute name on the envelope.
Send only by speed post/registered post to Principal/Nodal Officer, Government Industrial Training Institute, Durg, District Durg (C.G.) 491001.
Application must be received by 02-12-2026, 05:00 PM.
important_instructions: Separate application for each institute and trade/subject Number of posts may be reduced, increased or abolished Notarised affidavit on Rs. 50 stamp paper to be submitted on joining Decision of Joint Director (Training), Regional Office Durg is final in disputes

content_sections.heading: How Will Govt ITI Durg Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Stage 1: Data entry skill test Stage 2: Shorthand dictation skill test (100 marks, 100 wpm) Merit list on Stage 2 marks Stage 1: 15-minute data entry test of about 3,333 key depressions; minimum 2,500 correct key depressions to qualify Stage 2: 100-mark dictation test at 100 wpm; minimum 50 marks to pass; 1 mark deducted per error Merit list prepared only on Stage 2 marks Selection list pasted on notice board of nodal Govt ITI Durg Selected candidates informed by phone after Joint Director's approval

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Govt ITI Durg Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Govt ITI Durg Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 3 Guest Lecturer - Stenographer Secretarial Assistant (Hindi), 1 Guest Lecturer - Stenographer Secretarial Assistant (English).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Govt ITI Durg Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Appendix C (Parishisht Sa) of this notice; from the Principal's office or https://govtitidurg.org and https://cgiti.cg.gov.in/iti/durg) and send it to Principal/Nodal Officer, Government Industrial Training Institute, Durg, District Durg (C.G.) 491001, by speed post / registered post only, to reach by 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years (on the last date fixed for submission of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 140 per hour, max 5 hours per working day, max Rs. 15000 per month for Guest Lecturer - Stenographer Secretarial Assistant (Hindi), Rs. 140 per hour, max 5 hours per working day, max Rs. 15000 per month for Guest Lecturer - Stenographer Secretarial Assistant (English).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: (10+2) passed from a recognised board, or old Higher Secondary with first-year graduation passed. Also needed: a Hindi or English shorthand certificate with 100 wpm speed, and a one-year Data Entry Operator/Programming diploma or certificate with 10000 key depressions per hour. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a native (domicile) of Chhattisgarh state. Shorthand speed of 100 words per minute; 80 wpm may be considered by the Joint Director if no 100 wpm candidates. Data entry speed of 10000 key depressions per hour.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications without signature on the form and affidavit. Incomplete, unclear or faulty applications. Applications received after 02-12-2026, 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Stage 1: Data entry skill test. Stage 2: Shorthand dictation skill test (100 marks, 100 wpm). Merit list on Stage 2 marks. Stage 1: 15-minute data entry test of about 3,333 key depressions; minimum 2,500 correct key depressions to qualify.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Guest lecturer for training session 2026-27; no appointment letter is issued. Services end automatically when a regular, transferred or contract employee is posted. No leave of any kind admissible.
